title: Fixed Seven Wells and Individual Flip Lids Organizer
description: One newly authored complete empty static seven-compartment organizer exterior. A single long low case has a continuous floor, four perimeter walls and six integral full-height partitions creating seven genuine separate wells in one row. Seven complete individually tabbed lids each connect to their own full transverse fixed hinge barrel; the first fourth and seventh lids are fixed raised while the other four are fixed closed. All well walls, lid thicknesses, finger tabs and hinge barrels are actual geometry. Blank opaque surfaces with no day labels or pills. Fifteen closed editable meshes and three constant PBR roles, metres native Z up and whole bounds-centred ground datum. Entire case underside rests on ground. Entire new numeric geometry, not a rescaled six-compartment bait box or a single large cover subdivided for counting. One original model zero scenes. Artistic static geometry only: no medication, dosage or scheduling advice, storage suitability, child resistance, seal, latch operation, hinge animation, hygiene, capacity, manufacture or safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
